title: Four-star general says MJ-12 is real

tellings.quote: four-star general who was asked about the documents. He said they're real or the Majestic 12 is real.

plain: An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, tells of the Majestic 12 documents: papers said to describe a secret US group called Majestic 12 that dealt with UFOs. He says an unnamed four-star general was asked about the papers and said they are real, or that Majestic 12 itself is real. If true, it would mean a top US officer vouched for a secret UFO group at the highest level.
